email.subject: Smile Pros site: two quick fixes for Harbor Falls patients
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I looked at Smile Pros Dentistry's website. Two things are likely costing you new patients: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "dentist near me" have to copy your number manually instead of tapping to call — most just leave. And there are no patient reviews shown, which is often the deciding factor when someone's comparing dentists in Harbor Falls.

The footer is also outdated and the page title doesn't say what you do or where, which hurts how you show up in search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
